import joblib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.optimize import minimize,lsq_linear
mods={p.stem:joblib.load(p) for p in Path('artifacts').glob('*.joblib')}
y=next(iter(mods.values()))['y']; K=6; classes=next(iter(mods.values()))['classes']
print('train priors',dict(zip(classes,np.bincount(y)/len(y))))
for n in ['lgb_raw','lgb2_raw','xgb_raw','cat_raw','et_raw','svc_raw','lgb_eng','et_eng']:
 d=mods[n]; oy=d['oof'].argmax(1); ty=d['test'].argmax(1)
 C=np.array([np.bincount(oy[y==k],minlength=K)/np.sum(y==k) for k in range(K)]).T
 mu=np.bincount(ty,minlength=K)/len(ty)
 # bounded constrained sum via SLSQP
 fun=lambda q:np.sum((C@q-mu)**2)
 res=minimize(fun,np.ones(K)/K,bounds=[(0,1)]*K,constraints={'type':'eq','fun':lambda q:q.sum()-1})
 q=res.x
 # soft matrix average predicted probability given true
 S=np.array([d['oof'][y==k].mean(0) for k in range(K)]).T
 sm=d['test'].mean(0)
 res2=minimize(lambda q:np.sum((S@q-sm)**2),np.ones(K)/K,bounds=[(0,1)]*K,constraints={'type':'eq','fun':lambda q:q.sum()-1})
 print(n,'hardpred',dict(zip(classes,np.bincount(ty,minlength=K))), 'BBSE',np.round(q*300,1),'soft',np.round(res2.x*300,1))
